workarounds.symptom: search_graph: empty semantic_query array rejects BM25 calls and traps Claude Code in repeated validation failures
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(mcp): ignore empty semantic queries and clarify mode conflicts. Target files: src/mcp/mcp.c, tests/test_mcp.c. Accept `semantic_query: []` as an unused optional parameter instead of rejecting a BM25 request. The same empty-array meaning applies to structural search and the empty-query fallback, so it cannot accidentally select semantic-only output. (Ref: https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/pull/3016)

workarounds.symptom: Haskell: an escaped char literal followed by a primed name swallows the next definition (vendored tree-sitter-haskell)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(haskell): stop escaped char literals at the closing quote (#2439). Target files: scripts/audit-license-provenance.py, tools/tree-sitter-haskell/grammar.js, tools/tree-sitter-haskell/grammar/class.js. When a Haskell definition contains an escaped char literal (`'\n'`) and the next definition has a primed name (`g'`), the first definition swallows the second. With the repro from #2439, `f` spans lines 3-5 and `g'` gets no node. The parse also reports `has_error` even though the module is valid. The same bug ha... (Ref: https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/pull/2547)

workarounds.symptom: Windows: a file named `nul` in the repo makes every index_repository abort with aborted_previous_preserved (0.11.0)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(pipeline): skip a file named nul in the control-file walk instead of aborting the index (#2646). Target files: src/pipeline/pipeline_incremental.c, tests/test_pipeline.c. On Windows, one file named `nul` in a repository makes every `index_repository` run return `aborted_previous_preserved`, so a project without an index never gets one. Git Bash leaves such a file behind after `cmd > nul` or `2>nul`, and listing it in `.gitignore` does not help. (Ref: https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp/pull/2903)
